title: Payload check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for drive-loader-ar2 0.12's Drive payload table on the Analog Rytm MKII: a +Drive mod with a 225 KB .payload of a known pattern. After boot it walks the table (drive_payload_count, _at, _find, _info), tries the calls' edges, then reads its payload whole twice through dl_payload_read in 4 KB calls, 32 calls a tick, checking every word against the pattern and the sha256 of what it read against drive_payload_info's, and times the reads in DMA timer 0's counts, calibrated against 30 ticks. Its record follows the magic PCK1. A test, not for a project you keep.
